Madhya Pradesh CM announces UCC rule on multiple marriages

Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced that under the proposed Uniform Civil Code (UCC), individuals with only one spouse will have the right to reside in the state. This policy aims to restrict residency for those in polygamous relationships. The announcement was made in the context of implementing a UCC in the state.
